definitions.explanation: A traditional Japanese floor mat made of woven rush.

examples.japanese: {畳|たたみ}の{上|うえ}に{座|すわ}る。
{畳|たたみ}の{部屋|へや}で{寝|ね}る。
examples.english: To sleep in a tatami room.

examples.japanese: {新|あたら}しい{畳|たたみ}はいい{匂|にお}いがする。
この{部屋|へや}は{六畳|ろくじょう}の{和室|わしつ}です。
examples.english: This room is a six-tatami Japanese-style room.

examples.japanese: {畳|たたみ}が{古|ふる}くなったので{新|あたら}しいのに{変|か}えたい。
examples.english: The tatami mats have gotten old, so I want to replace them with new ones.

notes:
{畳|たたみ} is a traditional Japanese flooring.

MEASUREMENT:
{畳|じょう} is used as a unit for room size.
- {六畳|ろくじょう}: 6 tatami mats (about 10 sq meters)

CULTURE:
- Remove shoes before stepping on tatami
- Never step on the edges (borders)
- Common in traditional Japanese rooms
